note: Account figures the option screen sizes against (rules v7.6). balance = current account value from the ledger; base = $25,000 plus deposits minus withdrawals; phase = Proving or Pressing; rate = latest 3-month T-bill rate (FRED DTB3) as a fraction; min_score = the lowest call score you will trade; puts always need 10 (the plan trades puts at High conviction only). 9 = calls at 9+: a 9 is Medium conviction and must fit the Medium cap, 10+ is sized at the High cap, and a call whose contract fits only the High cap needs 10. 10 = High conviction only, which also sizes calls at the High cap; 7 = the plan's Medium tier. fed_bias = the direction the session's Fed Chessboard read supports (calls, puts, both or none); only that direction gets the Fed point in Max, and leaving it out gives it to both. The trading session updates this file when the ledger or its Fed read changes.
